text:
Marta: Heads up — observed steady resident-set creep in the KV cache for tenant 'atlas-prod' during long-context sessions (>8k tokens). Paging to NVMe spiked ~3x and we're seeing tail-latency pressure on a few small tenants. Posting pprof + eviction stats below.

perf-bot: Regression alert: KV cache grow-rate +12% vs baseline after last deploy (deploy 2026-03-17). See job perf/kv-growth-2475.

Kyle: ouch. Can you paste the pprof top10 / slab histo?

Marta: sure — trimmed pprof top: 
```
(pprof) top10
     65.3MB  65.3MB  runtime.mspanalloc
     45.8MB  45.8MB  runtime.mcache_refill
     31.1MB  31.1MB  kv/cache.pageObj
     12.7MB  12.7MB  kv/entry.kvSlice
```
Also eviction snapshot: `tenant=atlas-prod evict_count=3425 reload_count=3290` (10m window).

Jeff: atlas-prod runs a lot of longctx reranking; we suspected prefix reuse is low. That pprof looks like fragmentation + many small allocations.

Marta: yep — metric `kv.eviction_reload_ratio` for atlas-prod is 0.96 right now which points at churn rather than steady state.

sre-liz: what's the SLA impact? are other tenants seeing errors or just latency?

Marta: 95p latency for small tenants is up ~18% on p50 paths. No error spike yet, but some timeouts on the very tail.

Kyle: two quick hypotheses: 1) longctx requests pin large slices in KV and prevent reuse, 2) our batching heuristic chooses a different kernel variant for large-seq groups which increases per-request active window and increases residency. Kernel selection + batch sizing interplay could amplify the resident-set.

Maria: good notes. We should try a tenant-level soft cap experiment and collect reuse metrics. Proposed quick config to test in staging: 
```
kv:
  tenant_shares:
    atlas-prod: { soft: 0.25, hard: 0.5 }
  eviction_policy: "age+reuse-penalty"
  compaction_tick_seconds: 60
```
This would limit atlas to 25% of a node's KV pages soft, with hard stop at 50%.

Jeff: let's gray-release that to a staging replica of atlas-prod and replay longctx traffic. Measure paging, `kv.page_reuse_rate`, and `kv.eviction_reload_ratio`.

perf-bot: staging job queued: stg-9341. Running replay with longctx payloads (8k+).

Marta: I'll flip the soft cap tomorrow at 02:00 UTC and leave it on for a 2h replay run. Adding `kv.reuse_fingerprint` tracing to get per-segment reuse distribution.

Kyle: also add telemetry: per-tenant page reuse rate, eviction_reload_ratio, slab_free_fragmentation. Add an alert: `eviction_reload_ratio > 0.6` for >10m.

Maria: I'll wire a dashboard tile and a short alert runbook. Quick mitigation idea: temporarily raise small-tenant grace pages so they don't suffer tail latency while atlas is constrained.

Jeff: long-term we should consider periodic sampling compaction and a per-tenant lease that decays with inactivity (lease reclaimed faster for tenants with low reuse). Will write a short RFC.

Marta: action items: Marta -> run staging test + collect traces (owner), Kyle -> implement metrics + alert, Maria -> dashboard + runbook, Jeff -> RFC for compaction/lease.

Marta: thanks all — ping me if you want access to the staging job logs (stg-9341). :eyes: :rocket:
